text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (—Back then, I never could have imagined it.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then with that momentum,
go for it!
The Triple Tiara♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Only three people have ever achieved it, you know?
It's not that simple.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed, it is... a title granted only to the most exceptionally talented
even among the extraordinary Umamusume of the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "I shall claim the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Because the tiara...
suits me so well."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (I was resentful, but... to be honest, deep down inside—I had thought that if it was her, she might just make it.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(To think that I could be the one to hold it...
I couldn't truly believe it.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (...And yet right now, it is undeniably in my hands.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(This really... isn't a dream, is it...?
Me, a Triple Tiara Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis, Big Sis, Big Sis♡
Huge congratulations on winning the Triple Tiara♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Big sis. Sorry for being blunt earlier.
But I really think you're amazing.
Once again, congratulations on the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Verxina. I've told you so many times, but let me say it again... I want to tell you as many times as it takes. Congratulations on winning the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Verxina. I've told you so many times, but let me say it again... as many times as it takes. Congratulations on winning the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yaaay~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, Verxina-san has lately
been quietly celebrating late into the night..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Considering your current condition, I don't think it's very advisable, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They believe no one has noticed, and
above all, considering the reason behind it,
I just couldn't bring myself to point it out.
choice_data_list: So that's why you came to talk to me.
So that's why you came to talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes. She seems to think it's all a dream, so please make sure she knows it's reality!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, you're here!
Um, please, whatever you do, make sure they don't realize that I already know!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What were you two talking about
with Tarumae-san?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, recommendations
for famous Tomakomai sweets, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You really can't go wrong
by simply listening to her recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
what was it you wanted to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times people congratulate me, it still feels like a dream.
To think that I could actually become
a Triple Tiara Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because... standing before me was a truly...
truly massive wall.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I truly thought...
all I would ever do is watch her back from behind.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this really my reality?
Is it truly all right...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I end up feeling that way sometimes, too.
Strange, isn't it?"
It seems that while this feels like a dream come true to her, she's also bewildered, wondering, "Am I really good enough?" In that case—
choice_data_list: Well, it certainly feels real to me...
Well, it feels real enough to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Didn't I tell you back then?
Didn't I tell you back then?

text_block_list.text: "A tiara would look wonderful on you."
"‘A tiara would look wonderful on you, wouldn't it?’"

"Just as I had envisioned when I told her...
Verxina, having achieved the Triple Tiara, was truly beautiful and noble."

She who overcame fear, burned her fighting spirit to the end...
and held on through that very last stride—
only she is worthy of the Triple Tiara.
choice_data_list: You're not anyone's runner-up anymore—you're at the very top!
As you are now, you're not anyone's runner-up — you're at the very top!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
You're so right...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am...
I am the Triple Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I still have to take plenty of breaks, but...
once I can give it my all again—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I shall climb to the top once more!
—Aiming for the next summit!
